triggers._note: Replaces the old 'fall-with-injury' trigger (required TWO falls plus a separate binary injury question). Per Sharon: one serious fall can be enough — severity is what matters, not repetition. Fires on ANY selected red flag from the fall-severity checklist except 'none' / 'not-sure'. Pending Sharon's explicit sign-off on both the symptom list and the message wording before this leaves draft status.
triggers.message: One or more of these signs can indicate a serious injury or a medical emergency. If your parent lost consciousness, can't be woken easily, has a severe headache, repeated vomiting, a seizure, or sudden weakness/trouble speaking or seeing, call 911 now. For a possible fracture, inability to get up, or new confusion, seek urgent medical care today.

triggers._note: New per Sharon, 2026-09-06: being found on the floor should raise concern but NOT automatically mean 911 by itself — only an actual fall-severity red flag (the trigger above) does that. This targets take-action-soon, not get-immediate-help. If a real red flag is ALSO present, fall-severe-symptoms fires too and wins on severity rank — this trigger cannot suppress or downgrade that outcome.
triggers.message: Being found on the floor — especially unable to get up, unable to call for help, or for an unknown length of time — is a meaningful safety signal even without other symptoms. It deserves prompt follow-up with their doctor this week.
A sudden, clear change in confusion or alertness can signal an urgent medical issue (such as infection or medication reaction). Contact their doctor promptly, or seek urgent care.
